$description: A/W Design System colors. Generated from Figma (Foundation – UI 2) by scripts/build-tokens.mjs. $value is light mode; see $extensions['design.aw'].modes for light and dark. Use semantic tokens in components.

rules: Use semantic tokens (var(--color-bg-*), --color-text-*, --color-icon-*, --color-border-*) in components. Never use primitives or hex values directly.
Primitives (--color-<family>-<step>) only define what semantic tokens point to; add or change a semantic token in Figma rather than reaching for a primitive.
Match the category to the property: bg-* for backgrounds, text-* for text, icon-* for icons, border-* for borders and dividers.
Text and icons placed on a danger, warning or success fill use the matching on* tokens (e.g. --color-text-danger-ondanger on --color-bg-danger).
Interactive states use the -hover and -pressed variants of the same token, never a different hue.
Dark mode: semantic tokens switch automatically inside [data-theme="dark"]; don't add separate dark styles.

primitive.$description: Raw color scales from 100 (lightest) to 1000 (darkest). black and white are transparent scales (opacity steps); the others are solid. Some chromatic primitives have different values in dark mode.

black.$description: Black at increasing opacity — overlays, shadows, and neutral text/icon tints on light surfaces.

white.$description: White at increasing opacity — overlays and text/icon tints on dark or colored surfaces.

orange.$description: Accent orange (not yet used by any semantic token).

grey.$description: Solid neutrals for surfaces, borders and disabled states.

semantic.$description: Purpose-named tokens that point to primitives per mode. Use these in components.
